translation.name: Biblica® Se aɖeke mebla Biblia zazã o Agbenya La™

content.text: O! Yehowa, mele yɔwòm, va gbɔnye kaba.
Se nye gbe, ne meyɔ wò.
Nye gbedodoɖa neva gbɔwò abe dzudzɔ ʋeʋĩ ene,
eye na be nye asi siwo medo ɖe dzi la, nanɔ
na wò abe fiẽvɔsa ene.
O! Yehowa, ɖo dzɔla nye nu ŋu,
eye nɔ ŋudzɔ ɖe nye nuyi ƒe ʋɔtru ŋu.
Mègana be woahe nye dzi ɖe nu vɔ̃ɖi ŋuti,
be mayi gome kpɔ ge
le nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ me kple ŋutsu,
nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo o, eye mègaɖe mɔ be maɖu woƒe nuɖuɖu viviwo o.
Na ame dzɔdzɔe naƒom, enye dɔmenyo wòwɔ nam,
na wòaka mo nam, enye ami wòsi ɖe ta nam.
Nye ta magbe exɔxɔ o.
Gake nye gbedodoɖa tsia tsitre ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe wɔnawo ŋu ɖaa,
woatutu woƒe dziɖulawo tso togbɛwo dzi aƒu agame,
eye ame vɔ̃ɖiwo anya be megblɔ nye nyawo memie ɖe eteƒe.
Woagblɔ be, “Abe ale si ame ŋlɔa nu hedzoboa anyigbae ene la,
nenemae woakaka míaƒe ƒuwoe ɖe yɔdowo nu.”
O! Aƒetɔ Yehowa, meda nye ŋkuwo ɖe dziwò,
mewòe mebe ɖo, mègatsɔm na ku o.
Ɖem le mɔ siwo wotre nam la me,
tso mɔkli si nu tovo wɔlawo ɖo ɖi la me.
Na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo naɖo woawo ŋutɔ ƒe ɖɔwo me,
ne matso eme ayi le dedinɔnɔ me.
